{{ formfields }} {{ next_button }}

In phase 1, the three proposers make their offers for a division of the £5.00 bonus between themselves and the responder. They make an actual offer, which is how the money will actually be divided and they make a communicated offer, which is the offer the responder gets to see.

In phase 2, the responder observes the set of 3 communicated offers and decides whether to accept or reject this set of 3 communicated offers. If the set of 3 communicated offers is rejected, the game ends and nobody receives a bonus. If the set of 3 communicated offers is accepted, the game moves to phase 3.

In phase 3, the responder chooses one of the communicated offers. The actual offer that the chosen proposer has made is then implemented. The proposers that were not chosen will not receive a bonus.
